me.title: My devices
me.description: Your phones and computers connected to the network, and how to add a new one.

empty.title: No devices yet
empty.body: Add this phone or computer to reach your team's resources.

error.title: Your devices could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

me.blocked_one: {{count}} of your devices is blocked. Ask an administrator why.
me.blocked_other: {{count}} of your devices are blocked. Ask an administrator why.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: {{name}} loses access to the network straight away. To use it again you will have to add it as a new device. This cannot be undone.
remove.failed: {{name}} was not removed. Try again in a moment.
remove.gatewayInUse: Your other devices connect through {{name}}, so it cannot be removed from here. Ask an administrator.
remove.deviceBlocked: This device was blocked by an administrator: ask them to unblock or remove it.

rebuild.title: Set up {{name}} again?
rebuild.body: The current access stops working on {{name}} straight away. Right after, you make a new one with the same name.

downloads.title: Download apps
downloads.description: Install an app on the device, then add it here.
downloads.notPublished: NeroNet for {{platform}} is not published yet. Use the WireGuard app for now.
downloads.ios: On iPhone and iPad, install the official WireGuard app, then add the device from here.
downloads.wireguard: The official WireGuard app works on every kind of device.

link.desktop: WireGuard for Windows, macOS and Linux

add.title: Add a device
add.description: Choose the device, give it a name and create its access: it takes a minute.
add.name: Device name
add.nameHint: You will see it in your list. You can change it.
add.nameRequired: Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters.

result.title: Connect {{device}}
result.warning: The QR code and the file are your personal access. They are shown only once: do not share them with anyone.
result.install: Install the WireGuard app on {{device}}, if you do not have it yet.
result.scan: Scan with the WireGuard app on your phone.
result.getFileHere: Download the profile on this device.
result.getFileMove: Download the profile and pass it to the computer privately, for example with AirDrop, a cable or a USB stick. Not by email.

how.note: The names in quotes are the ones in the WireGuard app.

ios.import: Open WireGuard, tap + at the top right and choose "Create from file or archive". Pick the file you just downloaded and confirm when iPhone asks.
ios.scan: On the phone, open WireGuard, tap + at the top right and choose "Create from QR code". Then scan the code below, give it a name and confirm when iPhone asks.
ios.activate: Turn on the switch next to the connection.

android.import: Open WireGuard, tap + and choose "Import from file or archive". Pick the file you just downloaded (usually in the Download folder).
android.scan: On the phone, open WireGuard, tap + and choose "Scan from QR code". Then scan the code below and give it a name.
android.activate: Turn on the switch next to the connection and accept the Android prompt.

windows.import: Open WireGuard, click "Add Tunnel" at the bottom left and pick the file you just downloaded (usually in the Downloads folder).
windows.activate: Select the connection in the list and click "Activate".

macos.import: Open WireGuard from the menu bar at the top, choose "Manage tunnels", click + at the bottom left and "Import tunnel(s) from file", then pick the file you just downloaded.
macos.activate: Select the connection in the list and click "Activate".

wait.title: Waiting for your device…
wait.body: As soon as you turn the connection on, we see it here. You do not need to do anything else.
wait.slow: We do not see it yet. Check that you turned the connection on in the WireGuard app. If you cannot, you can set the access up again from your list of devices.

trouble.title: Trouble connecting?
trouble.body: Try copying the profile text and pasting it into the WireGuard app, or download the profile as a file.
trouble.file: Download the profile as a file

linux.intro: Put the file in the WireGuard folder and turn the connection on from the terminal:

error.noGateway: Your organisation is not ready to add devices yet. Ask an administrator to finish the setup.
error.keyInUse: This access was already in use. Try creating it again.
error.blockedOwner: You have a blocked device: an administrator must unblock it before you add another.
error.generic: We could not create the access. Try again.
error.noCrypto: This browser cannot protect the access. Open the page in a recent version of Chrome, Firefox, Safari or Edge.
error.exitNotPermitted: Only an administrator can send all traffic through the network: ask them, or create the access without this option.
error.exitGone: This option is no longer available. Try without it, or pick another place to go through.
error.methodGone: This way of connecting is no longer available. Choose another one and try again.

exit.toggle: Send all traffic through the network
exit.hint: The sites and apps you use also go through your organisation's network. Useful on public Wi-Fi.
exit.privacy: Whoever runs the network can see which sites you connect to, but not what you send to protected (HTTPS) sites.
exit.lanNote: To keep using printers and other devices on the network you are in, turn on "Exclude private IPs" in the connection settings in WireGuard.

strict.title: Networks that block VPNs (port 443)
strict.intro: For computers. Some networks, such as those in hotels, offices and guest Wi-Fi, let only the web through. With this method the connection goes over port 443, like a website, but it is slower: use it only when the profile above does not connect.
strict.run: Start this command and leave it open while you stay connected:
strict.import: Import this second file into the WireGuard app and turn it on instead of the first one. It uses the same keys but goes through the command above.
strict.download: Download the file for blocked networks
strict.secret: The command contains an address reserved for your organisation: do not publish it or share it outside your team.
strict.phones: On iPhone and Android the WireGuard app cannot use this method.

wireguard.title: Normal
wireguard.body: Fine almost everywhere: at home, at the office, on mobile data.

wireguard-wss.title: Network that blocks VPNs (port 443)
wireguard-wss.body: For hotels, offices and guest Wi-Fi that only let the web through. It is slower and needs one more program on the computer.

amneziawg.title: Network that recognises VPNs
amneziawg.body: For networks that spot and stop connections like this one. It uses the AmneziaWG app instead of WireGuard.

awg.install: Install the AmneziaWG app on {{device}}, if you do not have it yet. WireGuard is not enough: it has to be this one.
awg.note: The names in quotes are the ones in the AmneziaWG app: they may appear in English.

ios.import: Open AmneziaWG, tap + at the top right and choose "Create from file or archive". Select the file you just downloaded and confirm when iPhone asks.
ios.scan: On the phone open AmneziaWG, tap + at the top right and choose "Create from QR code". Then scan the code below, name it and confirm when iPhone asks.
ios.activate: Turn on the switch next to the connection.

android.import: Open AmneziaWG, tap + and choose "Import from file or archive". Select the file you just downloaded (usually in the Download folder).
android.scan: On the phone open AmneziaWG, tap + and choose "Scan from QR code". Then scan the code below and name it.
android.activate: Turn on the switch next to the connection and confirm Android's request.

windows.import: Open AmneziaWG, click "Add Tunnel" at the bottom left and choose the file you just downloaded (usually in the Download folder).
windows.activate: Select the connection in the list and click "Activate".

macos.import: Open AmneziaWG from the menu bar at the top, choose "Manage tunnels", click + at the bottom left and "Import tunnel(s) from file", then choose the file you just downloaded.
macos.activate: Select the connection in the list and click "Activate".
